issue.title: Note the CI runner in the docs, and bump checkout
issue.body:
Add one sentence to `docs/ci.md` (create it) saying CI runs `./scripts/gate.sh` on ubuntu-latest. Also bump `actions/checkout` in `.github/workflows/tests.yml` to `v8`.

## Done when

- `docs/ci.md` has the sentence.
- The workflow uses `actions/checkout@v8`.
